name: Shattered Self
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level bloodlord 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You turn into a swarm composed of fleshy bits that are the same size as your normal form. You gain the distract ability and swarm traits for the duration. You lose all weapon attacks but retain the ability to cast spells and a swarm attack that deals 1d4 per 4 caster levels you possess. All your other traits remain the same.
